test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

If I ______ a doctor, I would have treated you all.
solution:
The correct answer is '**were**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**were**'.

 
• "If I were you" is used when we give advice by imagining ourselves in the position of the other person.
 
• The structure of such sentences is as follows:-
 
 
• **If I were a doctor + I would/wouldn't + V1 + Object.**
 
 
 
• If I were you ... is used when giving advice about what you would do in the same situation as the other person.
 
• You **imagine** yourself in their position or situation and what you would do or how you would react.
 
• For Examples:-
 
 
• If I were you, I would study more.
 
• If I were you, I would stop doing that.
 
• If I were you, I would go to the doctor.
 
• If I were you, I wouldn't play with those wires.
 
 
 
• We can also change the order of the sentence.
 
• For Examples:-
 
 
• I would study more if I were you.
 
• I would be more careful if I were you.
 
• I wouldn't do that if I were you.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 1.

 

Correct Sentence:__* **If I **were** a doctor, I would have treated you all.*
